thresholds.name: Drover's bridge
thresholds.object: a stone bridge over the Rift gorge
thresholds.band: steppe, meadow, broadleaf -> scrub, meadow, steppe
thresholds.residents: the flock goes on to the far folds; a water-seller crosses to trade; lizards on the parapet; a vulture over the gorge

thresholds.name: the Amber canyon head
thresholds.object: the canyon head where the trail drops in
thresholds.band: desert, garden, meadow -> ash, desert, badland
thresholds.residents: a mule train comes down from the Lode with ore; orchard hands walk up from the fan; a vulture rides the canyon draught

thresholds.name: the Cinder Rise
thresholds.object: a ridge of cinders the trail crests
thresholds.band: ash, desert, badland -> ash, desert, lavastone
thresholds.residents: prospectors with sample bags go south; ash dust drifts north onto the bushes; a salamander basks on the ridge

thresholds.name: the chasm bridge
thresholds.object: a bridge over the young flow's chasm
thresholds.band: ash, desert, lavastone -> steppe, ash, scrub
thresholds.residents: carters bring charcoal and ore to the forge; Hearthold's gate guard walks the bridge; steam drifts across

thresholds.name: the Rift ferry
thresholds.object: the ferry landings and the ferryman's rope
thresholds.band: meadow, broadleaf, sand -> deadwood, meadow, blacksand
thresholds.residents: the ferryman (he lives here) takes fishers and goats across; terns and a black-sand beachcomber come the other way

thresholds.name: the crust causeway
thresholds.object: a causeway of laid slabs over the crusted flow
thresholds.band: deadwood, meadow, blacksand -> meadow, deadwood, blacksand
thresholds.residents: charcoal burners from Cinderwick carry sacks west; goats from the coast browse the dead forest's fireweed
